findings.message: <audio id="bgm"> has src but no data-start. HyperFrames cannot own playback for untimed media, so preview and render behavior can diverge.
findings.fixHint: Add data-start="0" (or the intended start time) and data-duration if the clip should stop before the source ends.

findings.message: Inline <script> imperatively controls managed media via play(). HyperFrames must own media play/pause/seek to keep preview, timeline, and renders deterministic.
findings.fixHint: Remove imperative media play/pause/currentTime/muted control. Express timing with data-start/data-duration and media offsets like data-media-start or data-playback-start instead.

findings.message: GSAP animation sets autoAlpha on a clip element. Selector "#scene1" resolves to element <div id="scene1" class="scene clip">. The framework manages clip visibility, and autoAlpha writes visibility as well as opacity. Do not animate these properties on clip elements.
findings.fixHint: Remove the visibility/display/autoAlpha tween, or move the content into a child <div> and target that instead.

findings.message: Track 0 has 5 timed elements in this HTML file. Smaller sub-compositions keep timelines easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Move coherent scene groups into separate .html files under compositions/ and mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so the timeline stays easier to inspect, revise, and validate.

findings.message: <div id="scene1"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="termBox">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="scene1"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.
